newsitem.title: USA: Donnelly says adding German unit lifted Q2 sales.
newsitem.headline: Donnelly says adding German unit lifted Q2 sales.

text.p: Donnelly Corp said Thursday its Donnelly Hohe subsidiary in Germany contributed $60.5 million to its overall sales in the second quarter of 1997.

Donnelly posted overall sales of $188 million, compared to $107 million in the same period one year ago. The compnay said the second quarter is the first in which the performance of Donnelly Hohe is included in its overall financial report.
Net income for the period totaled $3.9 million, compared to $2.6 million in the 1996 second quarter, Donnelly said.
Donnelly is an automotive products supply company.
Its shares closed unchanged Thursday at 23-3/8.
